foodOn.label: bakers yeast

citation.source: FoodOn (foodon.org), an OBO Foundry ontology, CC BY 4.0. Matched via EBI Ontology Lookup Service (OLS4) search API against the live FoodOn ontology, verified 2026-08-19.

foodOn.note: FoodOn's own search returned two near-duplicate classes for baker's yeast (FOODON:03310334 "bakers yeast" and FOODON:03413797 "baker's yeast") with no clear disambiguating description surfaced this session -- FOODON:03310334 was chosen for having an explicit food-role definition in the search result ("the common name for the strains of yeast commonly used in baking bread"); not independently confirmed as the canonical, non-deprecated term of the two.
